name: DbgLoadImageSymbols
why doing nothing is the console's answe: tells an attached kernel debugger about a loaded image; xbrt has no kernel debugger

name: DbgUnLoadImageSymbols
why doing nothing is the console's answe: tells an attached kernel debugger an image went away; xbrt has no kernel debugger

name: FscInvalidateIdleBlocks
why doing nothing is the console's answe: drops idle FATX cache blocks; the file layer is host files with no guest-side cache

name: HalEnableSystemInterrupt
why doing nothing is the console's answe: unmasks an interrupt line; xbrt never masks one (39, which would, is refused), so a connected interrupt is already delivered whenever its device raises it

name: HalRegisterShutdownNotification
why doing nothing is the console's answe: registers a callback run at shutdown or reboot; returning to the hub ends the process and no shutdown runs callbacks

name: IoDismountVolume
why doing nothing is the console's answe: volumes are host folders with no mount state; the next open sees what a remount would

name: IoDismountVolumeByName
why doing nothing is the console's answe: volumes are host folders with no mount state; the next open sees what a remount would

name: KeBoostPriorityThread
why doing nothing is the console's answe: a transient boost that decays on the console too; nothing reads it back

name: KeEnterCriticalRegion
why doing nothing is the console's answe: defers normal kernel APCs; xbrt delivers no kernel APCs (revisit with KeInsertQueueApc)

name: KeLeaveCriticalRegion
why doing nothing is the console's answe: ends the deferral KeEnterCriticalRegion began; xbrt delivers no kernel APCs

name: MmPersistContiguousMemory
why doing nothing is the console's answe: keeps memory across a reboot into the next XBE; xbrt runs one XBE per process

name: ObMakeTemporaryObject
why doing nothing is the console's answe: clears an object's permanent flag; xbrt objects are host handles and none is permanent

name: HalEnableSecureTrayEject
why doing nothing is the console's answe: lets the SMC eject the tray without a reboot; there is no tray

name: HalWriteSMCScratchRegister
why doing nothing is the console's answe: the scratch value is read by the next boot; there is no SMC and the hub ends the process

name: MmDbgReleaseAddress
why doing nothing is the console's answe: restores page protection after a debugger write; there is no debugger
